reels.title: Marvell will acquire Lumentum in a deal valued at $115 billion. 💵
reels.summary:
The transaction would be the largest merger between two publicly traded companies on record.

Lumentum shareholders will get 4.5 shares of Marvell stock for every Lumentum share they own. The agreement generates an enterprise value of approximately $115 billion, or $1,132 per share, a 23.9% premium over Lumentum's Oct. 28 closing share price.

reels.title: Palantir reported its Q3 earnings report. 📝

reels.title: Amazon could spend nearly $500 billion a year on AI: JPMorgan
reels.summary:
JPMorgan expects Amazon to pour $395 billion into capital expenditures in 2027, up 77% from this year’s estimated $220 billion, before climbing to $476 billion in 2028 as its AI buildout picks up. 

The forecast comes after CEO Andy Jassy said last week that Amazon would invest “meaningfully more” in 2027, though he didn’t give a number.
